agent_priors_used: Local-continuation / path-dependence prior (general agent prior, NOT SPIDER evidence): agents tend to refine the last local question because prior output is salient; a global director must periodically ask whether a thread's immediate children are globally the most valuable problems rather than locally available ones.

Measurement-first prior (general, NOT SPIDER evidence): when an instrument has repeatedly failed by construction (empty accept regions, controls that cannot fire, arithmetic ceilings), more estimator/threshold work has low marginal value until the instrument itself is repaired; a repair is often cheaper than another arm.

Single-repair-of-a-shared-prerequisite prior (general, NOT SPIDER evidence): when one missing capability blocks N downstream experiments across lanes, repair it once in its owning lane instead of re-attempting it inside every consumer; otherwise each consumer pays a full cycle to rediscover the same defect.

Repeated-identical-failure prior (general, NOT SPIDER evidence): several consecutive invalid designs of the same shape on the same substrate are evidence about the design and the substrate class, not about the world; changing the measured object is often the necessary move.

Shipped-path-demonstration prior (general software/agent prior, NOT SPIDER evidence): a capability demonstrated only in a research harness cannot be assumed to transfer to the product kernel; the executable round trip must be shown on the shipped path before expensive external benchmarks.

Discriminating-control prior (general measurement prior, NOT SPIDER evidence): a certificate that can only detect absence (substrate present) must additionally be shown to fire in the treatment arm (treatment can differ from comparator), or a null result is uninterpretable.
